width_buckets.merge_rule: Iteratively merge the globally smallest undersized bucket with its less-populated adjacent bucket; edge buckets merge inward. Width outcomes are never consulted.

classification_rules.broad_edge_deterioration: SUPPORTS when at least 60% of DEV-positive cells become VAL-nonpositive and median Avg-R delta is negative; PARTIAL when either condition holds.
classification_rules.parameter_migration: SUPPORTS when both Avg-R Spearman is <=0.25 and at least 60% of grouped descriptive optima shift; PARTIAL when either Spearman is <0.50 or at least 40% shift.
classification_rules.market_state_dependence: SUPPORTS when at least 40% of matched within-period width cells change sign and at least two durations have median absolute conditional Avg-R change >=0.15R; PARTIAL when either condition holds.
classification_rules.selection_error_overfitting: SUPPORTS when at least two frozen candidates had DEV Avg R > neighborhood DEV mean by >0.05R and then underperformed that neighborhood in VAL; PARTIAL when one does.
classification_rules.candidate_failure: BROAD_SURFACE_DETERIORATION when the broad rule supports and <=50% of neighbors remain VAL-positive; LOCAL_FAILURE when >50% remain positive and neighborhood VAL Avg R is positive; otherwise NEIGHBORHOOD_DETERIORATION.
